edits.new_content:
-- Metric 3: every milestone other than GTA 5's release falls inside the wait, so its output
-- by then (the day before) exists: from the day after GTA 5's release to GTA 6's release day.
select milestone_id, event_date, output_by_then
from {{ ref('fct_wait_milestones') }}
where event_date <> cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date)
  and (
    event_date <= cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date)
    or event_date > cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date)
    or output_by_then is null
  )

-- Metric 3: the wait holds every UTC day from GTA 5's release to the day before GTA 6's,
-- once each (4,811 days for 2013-09-17 to 2026-11-18).
select count(*) as days, min(output_day) as first_day, max(output_day) as last_day
from {{ ref('fct_world_output_daily') }}
having count(*) <> datediff('day', cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date), cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date))
    or min(output_day) <> cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date)
    or max(output_day) <> cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date) - 1

-- Metric 2 is measured from GTA 5's launch year: every measure needs its bookend value, or
-- every change since GTA 5 would read NULL.
select measure
from {{ ref('fct_world_productivity') }}
group by measure
having max(case when data_year = {{ var('gta_v_year', 2013) }} then value end) is null

-- Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: world real output in every
-- year from GTA 5's launch year to GTA 6's. One row per year.
-- World Bank WDI GDP (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD, constant 2015 US$, world aggregate). A year the World
-- Bank has not published is its last published value grown by the IMF WEO world real GDP
-- growth for each later year (total output: no population adjustment), flagged is_estimate.
-- A missing IMF year leaves that year and every later one NULL: unavailable, never zero.
with indicators as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_economy__indicators') }}
    where geo = 'WLD'
),

years as (
    select cast(unnest(range({{ var('gta_v_year', 2013) }}, {{ var('gta_6_year', 2026) }} + 1)) as integer) as year
),

actuals as (
    select year, value
    from indicators
    where provider = 'world_bank' and indicator = 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD'
),

last_actual as (
    select max(year) as last_year, arg_max(value, year) as last_value
    from actuals
),

gdp_growth as (
    select year, value as gdp_growth_pct
    from indicators
    where provider = 'imf_weo' and indicator = 'NGDP_RPCH'
),

spine as (
    select
        years.year,
        actuals.value as actual_value,
        last_actual.last_year,
        last_actual.last_value,
        gdp_growth.gdp_growth_pct
    from years
    left join last_actual on true
    left join actuals on actuals.year = years.year
    left join gdp_growth on gdp_growth.year = years.year
),

carried as (
    select
        *,
        case when year > last_year then 1 + gdp_growth_pct / 100 end as growth_factor
    from spine
),

valued as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when actual_value is not null then actual_value
            when growth_factor is not null and bool_and(growth_factor is not null) over chain
                then last_value * exp(sum(ln(growth_factor)) over chain)
        end as annual_output
    from carried
    window chain as (
        partition by year > last_year
        order by year
        rows between unbounded preceding and current row
    )
),

sized as (
    select
        *,
        datediff('day', make_date(year, 1, 1), make_date(year + 1, 1, 1)) as days_in_year
    from valued
)

select
    year as data_year,
    annual_output,
    actual_value is null and annual_output is not null as is_estimate,
    days_in_year,
    annual_output / days_in_year as daily_output,
    annual_output / days_in_year / 86400 as output_per_second,
    'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD' as source_indicator
from sized

-- Metric 3: each milestone of the wait, placed on the running total of world real output.
-- output_by_then is the running total through the day before the event: "by the time it
-- happened, the world had made $X since GTA 5". GTA 5's own release day has made nothing yet
-- since GTA 5, so it reads 0; any other milestone outside the wait reads NULL.
with milestones as (
    select * from {{ ref('wait_milestones') }}
),

daily as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_world_output_daily') }}
),

wait as (
    select arg_max(cumulative_output, output_day) as wait_output
    from daily
)

select
    milestones.milestone_id,
    milestones.event_date,
    milestones.date_precision,
    milestones.category,
    milestones.tier,
    milestones.is_editorial,
    milestones.title,
    milestones.chart_label,
    milestones.why,
    milestones.source_url,
    case
        when milestones.event_date = cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date) then 0
        else daily.cumulative_output
    end as output_by_then,
    output_by_then / wait.wait_output as share_of_wait_output,
    datediff('day', cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date), milestones.event_date) as days_since_gta_v,
    datediff('day', milestones.event_date, cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date)) as days_to_gta_6
from milestones
left join wait on true
left join daily on daily.output_day = milestones.event_date - 1

-- Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: one row per UTC day of the
-- wait, from GTA 5's release (var gta_v_date) to the day before GTA 6's (var gta_6_date),
-- with that day's world real output and the running total since GTA 5.
-- Days are generated here: the wait (2013 to 2026) is wider than the semantic time spine.
-- A day whose year has no output reads NULL, and so does every running total from it on.
with days as (
    select cast(range as date) as output_day
    from range(cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date), cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date), interval 1 day)
),

yearly as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_world_output__yearly') }}
),

daily as (
    select
        days.output_day,
        cast(year(days.output_day) as integer) as data_year,
        yearly.daily_output,
        yearly.is_estimate
    from days
    left join yearly on yearly.data_year = year(days.output_day)
)

select
    output_day,
    data_year,
    daily_output,
    is_estimate,
    case
        when bool_and(daily_output is not null) over wait
            then sum(daily_output) over wait
    end as cumulative_output,
    datediff('day', cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date), output_day) + 1 as days_since_gta_v,
    datediff('day', output_day, cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date)) as days_to_gta_6
from daily
window wait as (order by output_day rows between unbounded preceding and current row)

        population:

            chosen: 2013-09-17 through 2026-11-18, every UTC day
            evidence: request
            detail: 'user: bookended by the two releases; GTA 6 unlocks 2026-11-19 00:00 UTC, the site countdown''s moment'

          - decision: What drives the days
            chosen: a range() of days generated in SQL, not metricflow_time_spine
            evidence: default
            detail: the time spine covers 2025-2027 only; widening it would change a model Metric 1 reads
            column: output_day
          - decision: Running total across an unavailable day
            chosen: NULL from that day on
            evidence: contract
            detail: 'AGENTS.md: a NULL is unavailable, never zero; a total that skipped a year would understate'
            column: cumulative_output

-- Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6: world productivity in every year from GTA 5's launch year to
-- GTA 6's, and its real change since GTA 5. One row per measure per year.
--   output_per_worker: World Bank GDP per person employed (constant 2021 PPP $).
--   output_per_person: World Bank GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$).
-- A year the World Bank has not published is estimated for output_per_person only: its last
-- published value grown by the IMF's world real GDP growth for each later year, less the
-- World Bank's latest world population growth. output_per_worker stays NULL there
-- (unavailable): no published world employment growth to carry it.
{%- set gta_v = var('gta_v_year', 2013) %}
{%- set gta_6 = var('gta_6_year', 2026) %}
with indicators as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_economy__indicators') }}
    where geo = 'WLD'
),

measures as (
    select * from (
        values
            ('output_per_worker', 'SL.GDP.PCAP.EM.KD', 'constant 2021 PPP $ per person employed', false),
            ('output_per_person', 'NY.GDP.PCAP.KD', 'constant 2015 US$ per person', true)
    ) as m (measure, source_indicator, unit, carried_by_imf)
),

years as (
    select cast(unnest(range({{ gta_v }}, {{ gta_6 }} + 1)) as integer) as year
),

actuals as (
    select indicator, year, value
    from indicators
    where provider = 'world_bank'
),

last_actual as (
    select indicator, max(year) as last_year, arg_max(value, year) as last_value
    from actuals
    group by indicator
),

gdp_growth as (
    select year, value as gdp_growth_pct
    from indicators
    where provider = 'imf_weo' and indicator = 'NGDP_RPCH'
),

pop_growth as (
    select arg_max(value, year) as pop_growth_pct
    from indicators
    where provider = 'world_bank' and indicator = 'SP.POP.GROW'
),

spine as (
    select
        measures.measure,
        measures.source_indicator,
        measures.unit,
        measures.carried_by_imf,
        years.year,
        actuals.value as actual_value,
        last_actual.last_year,
        last_actual.last_value,
        gdp_growth.gdp_growth_pct,
        pop_growth.pop_growth_pct
    from measures
    cross join years
    cross join pop_growth
    left join actuals
        on actuals.indicator = measures.source_indicator and actuals.year = years.year
    left join last_actual
        on last_actual.indicator = measures.source_indicator
    left join gdp_growth
        on gdp_growth.year = years.year
),

carried as (
    select
        *,
        -- Per-capita growth factor for a year past the last published one; NULL if the IMF
        -- has no growth for it, and a NULL anywhere in the chain keeps the rest NULL.
        case
            when carried_by_imf and year > last_year
                then (1 + gdp_growth_pct / 100) / (1 + pop_growth_pct / 100)
        end as growth_factor
    from spine
),

valued as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when actual_value is not null then actual_value
            when growth_factor is not null and bool_and(growth_factor is not null) over chain
                then last_value * exp(sum(ln(growth_factor)) over chain)
        end as value
    from carried
    window chain as (
        partition by measure, year > last_year
        order by year
        rows between unbounded preceding and current row
    )
),

based as (
    select
        valued.*,
        max(case when year = {{ gta_v }} then value end) over (partition by measure) as gta_v_value,
        max(case when value is not null then year end) over (partition by measure) as latest_year
    from valued
)

select
    md5(measure || '|' || cast(year as varchar)) as world_productivity_key,
    measure,
    year as data_year,
    make_date(year, 1, 1) as year_start,
    case year when {{ gta_v }} then 'GTA 5' when {{ gta_6 }} then 'GTA 6' end as launch,
    value,
    unit,
    source_indicator,
    actual_value is null and value is not null as is_estimate,
    year = latest_year as is_latest,
    round(100 * (value / gta_v_value - 1), 1) as pct_change_since_gta_v
from based

- name: fct_world_productivity
  description: 'Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6: world productivity per year from 2013 to 2026 and its real change
    since GTA 5''s launch year. One row per measure per year.'
  config:
    meta:

        - decision: Measures of productivity

          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: productivity measured by actual economic indexes (GDP per capita) for the whole
            world, economic data only'
          column: measure

          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: bookended by the GTA 5 and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)'
          column: data_year
        - decision: Years the World Bank has not published
          chosen: per capita carried by IMF WEO world real GDP growth less latest World Bank population
            growth, flagged is_estimate; per worker left NULL

version: 2
seeds:
- name: wait_milestones
  description: 'Metric 3: moments between GTA 5 and GTA 6, one row per milestone, each dated to a UTC
    day and carrying one public source. is_editorial marks the ones the chart draws.'
  config:
    column_types:
      event_date: date
      is_editorial: boolean
  columns:
  - name: milestone_id
    description: Slug, e.g. black_hole_image.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: event_date
    description: UTC day the event happened.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: date_precision
    description: day, or month when only the month is certain.
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - day
          - month
  - name: category
    description: Theme of the milestone; rockstar marks the Rockstar nods.
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - ai
          - computing
          - culture
          - health
          - humanity
          - physics
          - planet
          - release
          - rockstar
          - space
  - name: tier
    description: anchor (the two releases), hero (headline moments) or long.
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - anchor
          - hero
          - long
  - name: is_editorial
    description: 'True for the editorial milestones: the ones drawn on the Metric 3 chart.'
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: title
    description: What happened, in a sentence.
  - name: chart_label
    description: Short label for the chart.
  - name: why
    description: Why it is on the list.
  - name: source_url
    description: One public source for the date.
